analysis: Documentation-only changes. docs/architecture/inference.md head line 1353 adds a note that gpt_oss bf16 checkpoints keep bf16 activations and native K/V on every layer (citing GPTOSS+Experts.swift swiglu). docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md head line 689 updates gpt-oss-20b SSD checkpoint size figures from float32 K/V on 23 of 24 layers (308 MB at 6,144 tokens) to bf16 K/V on all 24 layers (154.1 MB). Relative to T-041 (encrypted SSD prefix cache), these change only per-file size estimates; the documented residual at-rest metadata (uniform file sizes, count, mtimes) is already accepted and does not confirm a specific prefix. No change to the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate, TTL, HMAC naming, DBK3 AAD, salt scoping, budgets or the per-donation gate is described. Smaller files could marginally affect disk-budget/endurance math, but that is availability-neutral or favorable. The underlying code change (dtype handling in GPTOSS swiglu / K/V dtype) is not in this batch; if code changed K/V dtype, integration should confirm the paged/contiguous observed-dtype validation (CBv2PagedKVWriteValidation) and layoutEpoch/weightHash bindings still fail closed against previously written float32 checkpoints, but no evidence here indicates a regression. Remaining surrounding text in unit 10/11 is unchanged.
